questions.question: Which visual direction should the coffee roaster landing page take?

options.label: Warm artisan
options.description: Cream and kraft-paper tones, espresso brown and terracotta accents, serif headings, hand-drawn bean illustrations, cozy small-batch feel.

options.label: Modern minimal
options.description: Mostly white with lots of space, near-black type, one muted sage accent, clean geometric sans, product shots on a tight grid.

options.label: Bold retro
options.description: Saturated 70s palette of mustard, burnt orange and teal, chunky display type, badge graphics, playful packaging-led layout.

questions.question: Which look should the analytics dashboard for the SaaS app have?

options.label: Dark pro
options.description: Charcoal background, neon cyan and magenta chart lines, dense KPI tiles, left sidebar nav, monospace numbers.

options.label: Light airy
options.description: White canvas, soft blue accent, large rounded cards with generous padding, top nav, friendly sans.

options.label: Data dense
options.description: Grey grid of many small panels, tables first, tiny sparklines, compact type, traffic-light status colours.

options.label: Branded bold
options.description: Deep purple header band, one big hero metric, bright coral accent, illustrated empty states.

questions.question: Which visual style for the mobile fitness app home screen?

options.label: Energetic
options.description: Black background, electric lime accent, huge progress ring, bold condensed type, chunky pill buttons.

options.label: Calm wellness
options.description: Pale sand and sage, soft rounded cards, serif greeting, gentle circular progress, lots of breathing room.

options.label: Clinical
options.description: White and cool grey, single blue accent, precise data rows, small charts, medical-grade feel.

questions.question: Which layout direction for a photographer portfolio site?

options.label: Full bleed
options.description: Edge-to-edge hero image, name overlaid in thin white sans, minimal top-right menu, dark overall.

options.label: Gallery grid
options.description: Off-white page, masonry grid of thumbnails, small black serif name top-left, quiet and editorial.

options.label: Magazine
options.description: Big serif headline, two-column story layout, red accent rules, one large photo and captions.

options.label: Brutalist
options.description: Raw grey, black borders everywhere, mono type, oversized index numbers, harsh yellow highlight.

questions.question: Which design for the restaurant menu web page?

options.label: Bistro
options.description: Cream paper, deep green and gold, classic serif, dotted leaders between dish and price, framed header.

options.label: Street food
options.description: Bright red and yellow, hand-painted sign feel, big bold sans, photo tiles of dishes, order button.

options.label: Fine dining
options.description: Black page, thin gold type, very sparse, one course at a time, elegant centred layout.

questions.question: Which visual direction for a dark-fantasy game main menu?

options.label: Gothic
options.description: Near-black with blood red and bone white, ornate serif title, candle-lit vignette, stacked menu items left.

options.label: Cold north
options.description: Steel blue and frost white, runic accents, mountain silhouette backdrop, centred menu, thin sans.

options.label: Ember
options.description: Charcoal and glowing orange embers, ash grey panels, heavy title at top, menu as bottom row of buttons.
